title: Microsoft 365 Backup: activity logs for policy and restore operations
summary: Hold: the Purview retention guidance omits add-on licences that also qualify users for one-year retention, making its blanket 180-day statement for non-E5 users inaccurate. The activity-log routes, roles, retention, roadmap facts and beta API are supported.

claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Backup Activity Logs provide an in-product view of backup policy and restore operations.

claims.quote: Use activity logs for operational monitoring and troubleshooting.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes tracking backup configuration and restore tasks to help troubleshooting, monitoring, reporting and auditing.
claims.quote: In product monitoring logs to track all activities related to backup policy configuration & restore related tasks. This will help admins with troubleshooting, monitoring, reporting and auditing capabilities.
